H1.question: Does posterior calibration (posterior predictive mixture over the v0.6 14-parameter family) reduce the v0.6 calibration objective relative to the v0.6 point-calibrated baseline on fresh temporal data?
H1.estimator: objective(G0-post posterior predictive: 16 posterior draws x 2 seeds x 3600 s, pooled sketches) - objective(G0 v0.6 selected point model: 32 seeds x 3600 s); objective = v0.6 sealed objective (mean family error / development-half scale)
H1.sample_unit: 600 s historical blocks; simulated seeds (point) or (draw, seed) units (posterior)
H1.uncertainty: paired moving-block bootstrap of 600 s historical blocks (block length 1) with independent seed-level bootstrap of each model's simulations, 2000 resamples
H1.threshold: Bonferroni two-sided interval upper bound < 0 on each day; the hypothesis is ESTABLISHED only if both days are ESTABLISHED
H1.failure_semantics: interval lower bound > 0 on any day: FAILED; otherwise NOT_ESTABLISHED; download failure: NOT_AVAILABLE
H1.secondary: 90% posterior predictive interval coverage of the 85 component statistics per block (descriptive, with calibration curve)
H1.label: FRESH

H2.question: Does a richer generator reduce classifier distinguishability of real and simulated 60 s windows relative to the G0 point baseline on fresh temporal data?
H2.estimator: held-out ROC-AUC(family) - ROC-AUC(G0) of the sealed v0.6 primary logistic classifier (feature whitelist unchanged) for each richer family and fresh temporal day
H2.sample_unit: 60 s windows; real windows chronological split with 10 min purge; simulated windows grouped by seed
H2.uncertainty: 10-window block bootstrap of real windows paired across families, seed-group bootstrap of simulated windows, 2000 resamples
H2.failure_semantics: lower bound > 0: FAILED for that member; both AUCs with interval lower bound >= 0.99: NOT_ESTABLISHED with qualifier VACUOUS (ceiling); generator not available: NOT_AVAILABLE
H2.status_rule: per member; summary ESTABLISHED if any member ESTABLISHED
H2.label: FRESH

H3.question: Does a richer generator increase historical support coverage on fresh temporal data?
H3.estimator: fraction of real 60 s windows inside support (v0.6 5-NN rule, 99th percentile leave-one-seed-out threshold computed on the family's own simulated windows) for family minus G0
H3.uncertainty: 10-window block bootstrap of real windows, seed-group bootstrap of simulated windows, 2000 resamples
H3.threshold: Bonferroni interval lower bound > 0 and estimate >= 0.05
H3.failure_semantics: upper bound < 0: FAILED; otherwise NOT_ESTABLISHED; coverage of both below 1%: qualifier VACUOUS
H3.label: FRESH

H4.question: Does the selected generator G* improve on the G0 baseline cross-instrument?
H4.estimator: objective(G*) - objective(G0) with the ETH development scale and tick geometry applied unchanged
H4.uncertainty: paired moving-block bootstrap of 600 s historical blocks (block length 1) with independent seed-level bootstrap of each model's simulations, 2000 resamples
H4.failure_semantics: lower bound > 0: FAILED; otherwise NOT_ESTABLISHED; download failure: NOT_AVAILABLE
H4.label: FRESH

H5.question: Does the selected generator G* improve on the G0 baseline cross-venue?
H5.estimator: as H4 on BitMEX XBTUSD; venue effect reported as the BitMEX minus Deribit BTC same-day objective difference (descriptive)
H5.uncertainty: paired moving-block bootstrap of 600 s historical blocks (block length 1) with independent seed-level bootstrap of each model's simulations, 2000 resamples
H5.failure_semantics: as H4; an adapter that cannot produce the canonical L2 tape without inventing fields makes H5 NOT_AVAILABLE
H5.label: FRESH

H6.question: Is the G0-post posterior multimodal (materially distinct high-posterior regions)?
H6.estimator: number of clusters among final-generation particles separated by more than 0.25 of the transformed range in at least one parameter and each holding >= 5% posterior mass
H6.uncertainty: cluster count across 3 independent SMC-ABC runs
H6.threshold: count >= 2 in at least 2 of 3 runs
H6.failure_semantics: count = 1 in at least 2 of 3 runs: NOT_ESTABLISHED; non-convergence: INCONCLUSIVE
H6.label: DEVELOPMENT

H7.question: Is model uncertainty material to execution cost?
H7.estimator: for each primary agent: between-world SD of mean completion-adjusted cost across the plausible world set divided by the pooled within-world seed SE of the world means
H7.threshold: Holm-adjusted one-sided lower bound of the ratio > 1 and between-world SD >= 0.5 bps
H7.failure_semantics: upper bound < 1: FAILED (model uncertainty below seed noise); otherwise NOT_ESTABLISHED
H7.status_rule: per agent; summary ESTABLISHED if any agent ESTABLISHED
H7.label: SIMULATION

H8.question: Is at least one pairwise policy comparison robust across model uncertainty?
H8.estimator: pooled mean cost difference across the plausible world set for each of the 28 primary-agent pairs
H8.threshold: ROBUST_ACROSS_MODEL_UNCERTAINTY if: pooled interval at alpha 0.05/28 excludes 0; |pooled mean| >= 1 bps; no world has a determinate (alpha 0.05/28 per world) difference of the opposite sign; and the worst plausible world (adversarial search restricted to the 90% posterior region) keeps the sign
H8.failure_semantics: all four conditions fail to hold for every pair: NOT_ESTABLISHED; a world with a determinate opposite sign: that pair is MODEL_DEPENDENT
H8.status_rule: per pair edge type; summary ESTABLISHED if any pair is ROBUST_ACROSS_MODEL_UNCERTAINTY
H8.label: SIMULATION

H9.question: Does at least one ranking that looks stable in a single world become MODEL_DEPENDENT or INCONCLUSIVE under model uncertainty?
H9.estimator: count of pairs determinate in the G0 point world (alpha 0.05/28) whose H8 edge type is MODEL_DEPENDENT, INDETERMINATE or REVERSED
H9.failure_semantics: no single-world-determinate pair: NOT_EVALUABLE reported as INCONCLUSIVE
H9.label: DEVELOPMENT

H10.question: Does execution-aware calibration improve execution-sensitive realism?
H10.estimator: execution-sensitive objective (mean error of the sealed ES families: spread, L1 depth, depletion and replenishment hazards, aggressive event size, 10 s signed event volume autocorrelation) of the execution-aware posterior mode minus G0
H10.uncertainty: paired moving-block bootstrap of 600 s historical blocks (block length 1) with independent seed-level bootstrap of each model's simulations, 2000 resamples
H10.threshold: Bonferroni interval upper bound < 0 on each day
H10.failure_semantics: lower bound > 0 on any day: FAILED; otherwise NOT_ESTABLISHED
H10.label: FRESH

H11.question: Is the H10 improvement not metric overfitting (generic realism not materially worse)?
H11.estimator: generic v0.6 objective of the execution-aware model minus G0
H11.uncertainty: paired moving-block bootstrap of 600 s historical blocks (block length 1) with independent seed-level bootstrap of each model's simulations, 2000 resamples
H11.threshold: noninferiority: Bonferroni one-sided upper bound < delta on each day
H11.margin: delta = 0.10 x G0 selection-day objective (computed and sealed before holdout access)
H11.failure_semantics: lower bound > delta: FAILED (metric overfitting); otherwise NOT_ESTABLISHED
H11.status_rule: per day plus conjunction; evaluated only together with H10
H11.label: FRESH

H12.question: Does posterior (domain-randomized) training improve historical transfer of learned policies relative to single-world training?
H12.estimator: |simulated cost - bounded historical replay cost| of posterior-trained minus single-world-trained policies, averaged over training seeds and replay episodes
H12.sample_unit: replay episodes (training seeds as a second stage)
H12.failure_semantics: lower bound > 0: FAILED; otherwise NOT_ESTABLISHED; replay INVALID rate > 5%: INVALID
H12.status_rule: per member (PPO, DQN x conservative, optimistic fill bound)
H12.label: HISTORICAL_BOUNDED

H13.question: Do the robust simulator conclusions (H8) survive historical replay under both fill bounds?
H13.estimator: for each H8-robust pair: sign and Bonferroni-determinacy of the replay cost difference under the conservative and optimistic bounds
H13.threshold: same sign and determinate under both bounds
H13.failure_semantics: no H8-robust pair: NOT_EVALUABLE reported as INCONCLUSIVE; opposite determinate sign: FAILED
H13.label: FRESH

generic: Every hypothesis states its question, estimator, datasets, sample unit, uncertainty method, family, threshold, margin and failure semantics before any holdout access.
